title: TAIFEX refresh before stack mutation fails every dev deploy
author: Claude
hosted_execution_disclaimer: Local reproduction and local tests only. Hosted verification was NOT run: no hosted workflow was dispatched, no VM or SSH connection was opened, no operator key or service secret was read. The coordinator verifies through the normal auto deploy after merge.

reproduced_error.error: ControllerTickError: desired-state reconcile failed closed: conflicts=1 unsupported=0
reproduced_error.root_cause: The bounded TAIFEX one-shot reconciles the deployment desired state that prepare_bounded_source_refresh_dataset extended with a tw-taifex-futures-options-chip live_pull requirement carrying policy gate require_connector_approved. The reconciler's gate (services/source_ingestion/persona_source_reconciler.py:383 at HEAD, a file outside this task's scoped artifacts, so it was not edited) passed only for connector ids in provider_factories (FinMind, TW official) or connectors whose metadata says approved. The registered TAIFEX connector has neither, so the action was status=conflict, connector_action=policy_gate_failed, failed_policy_gates=[require_connector_approved]. The tick aborts at reconcile, before frontier recovery and before run-scheduled, so the frontier item stays queued with attempts 0 and last_error null, no source_health line is written, and the one-shot exits 1. This matches every VM observation in the task brief.
reproduced_error.second_defect_found_after_first_fix: With the gate fixed, the same local run then failed in services/source_ingestion/controller_worker.py _validate_terminal_readback because an exclusive TAIFEX tick still demanded freshness, health and a normalized record for tw-twse-tpex-official-market, which is in the desired state but is never pulled by that tick (freshness_not_accepted, freshness_outside_cadence, normalized_record_missing, source_health_not_ok). It would have been the next hosted failure.
reproduced_error.ruled_out: HTTP fetch, 100 record cap, weekend condition, egress hosts and slow startup were not the cause: with the fix the TAIFEX run completed with raw_count=25 normalized_count=25 rejected_count=0 using SOURCE_INGEST_MAX_RECORDS=100 and live TAIFEX hosts.

local_reproduction_method: In-process uvicorn real services.source_ingestion.main app on a temp data dir; the exact PREPARE_DATASET_PY snippet extracted from scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh was run against it with connector tw-taifex-futures-options-chip, dataset taifex_ssf_contracts, symbols 2317.TWSE,0050.TWSE,2330.TWSE,2330.TW; its output was used as SOURCE_INGEST_DESIRED_STATE_PATH; then controller_worker.run_controller_tick ran with mode reconcile_and_pull, truth reconciled_live_proof, exclusive and force connector tw-taifex-futures-options-chip, max concurrency 1, PANTHEON_EXTERNAL_EGRESS=allowlist with openapi.taifex.com.tw,www.taifex.com.tw, SOURCE_INGEST_MAX_RECORDS=100. Final run result: status=ok, schedule total_ran=1 total_failed=0.

changes.summary: TaifexDerivativesChipAdapter.connector() metadata now declares approval_status=approved with approval_authority=code_reviewed_public_official_reference, which the existing require_connector_approved gate already honors for registered connectors. Chosen over editing persona_source_reconciler.py because that file is outside the scoped artifacts. The connector is public (auth none, no secret); all other gates are unchanged and a connector with approval_status other than approved still fails closed.

_validate_terminal_readback with an exclusive scope validates only the selected connectors, and fails closed (exclusive_connector_not_reconciled) if a selected connector was not reconciled. Selected connectors keep every freshness, health, record and provenance check.

wait_for_bounded_source_refresh_service prints the last 200 container log lines, with Bearer values and JWT-like strings redacted, when a bounded one-shot exits non-zero or enters dead state, before the error and before the container is removed.

gates_not_weakened: Egress allowlist unchanged, lease and preflight unchanged, restore_bounded_source_refresh (egress deny and reconcile_only) unchanged and its existing tests green. The TAIFEX step was not removed and PAPER_BOOTSTRAP_REQUESTED was not touched. Safe skips (weekend, holiday, session_not_closed) are still reported by check_taiwan_refresh_preflight as skipped with a reason (test_preflight_weekend_skip, test_taiwan_preflight_taifex_ssf_does_not_skip_when_twse_is_fresh); fetch, contract and authority failures still fail closed (test_refresh_entrypoint_taifex_fails_closed_on_token_or_desired_state_exec_failure, the new reconciler negative tests).
not_done: No readiness wait before docker compose run was added: slow startup was not proven as a cause (task brief item 3) and the local reproduction does not need it.
